gaps: FY2026-27 final budget (Res. 26-12, /media/10891) is listed on the Finance page, but could not be downloaded on 2026-10-21. Springfield's site host, CivicPlus, had a service disruption that day: status.civicplus.com reported 'Municipal Websites Open' taken offline over a PHP security vulnerability, and requests redirected there. The HR and resolutions pages were unavailable too. Retry once service is restored.

No line-item budget, position list, pay plan, or salary figures are published. Springfield posts only budget resolutions with department totals. Request: (1) the FY2026-27 line-item budget with salary, overtime and benefit accounts by department; (2) the authorized position list with budgeted salary per position (no names); (3) the pay plan / step schedule for police, fire and general employees.
Salaries of the Mayor and Commissioners (charter or ordinance), City Clerk, Finance Director, Police Chief and Fire Chief. Request them.
Union contracts (police/fire): none found. Request any CBA, or confirm none exist.
No city manager: the commission oversees staff directly, with a City Clerk.
